name: dsh-lmstudio-router
description: Local LM Studio model router for the dsh web GUI: routes token-expensive bulk tasks (text work, compaction, session titles) to a local LM Studio model over its OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint, auto-launches LM Studio, and fits requests into the model context window. Zero-dependency host plugin.
